title: The Golden Spoon Heist
description: The museum's ancient Roman solid golden spoon was replaced with a cheap neon yellow plastic spork.
setting: The Gilded Antiquities Wing of the Metropolitan Museum

title: The Decaf Conspiracy
description: The city hall espresso machine's dark roast beans were swapped with pulverized chicory and decaf crystals.

title: The Flaming Flamingo Flap
description: All 37 plastic lawn flamingos along Maple Street were dressed in hand-knitted turtleneck sweaters overnight.
setting: The Pristine Suburban Lawns of Whisper Pines

title: The Helium Philharmonic
description: The opera house pipe organ was pumped full of helium gas right before the opening crescendo of Don Giovanni.

title: The Cuckoo Clock Mutiny
description: The master gears in the astronomical town clock were reprogrammed so the cuckoo shrieks like an enraged rooster.

title: The Stolen Secret Sourdough
description: A 140-year-old sourdough starter named 'Mother Bready' vanished from the locked bakery cellar.

title: The Velvet Toupee Switcheroo
description: Chief Magistrate Sterling's ceremonial horsehair wig was swapped with an orange sherpa fleece beanie.
setting: The High Court Judicial Robing Chamber

title: The Midnight Polka Broadcast
description: The city emergency alert broadcast system was hijacked to loop Bavarian accordion polka for twenty minutes.

title: The Mayoral Wax Doppelganger
description: The wax museum's likeness of the mayor was found seated behind the real mayor's mahogany desk holding a donut.

title: The Missing Blue Ribbon Squash
description: Farmer Jed's 400-pound record-setting winter squash was painted with green stripes and rolled into the pond.

title: The Great Library Dewey Scramble
description: Every single book on quantum mechanics was interfiled under 641.5 (Hearty Crockpot Recipes).

title: The Aquarium Bubble Bath Incident
description: Ten gallons of strawberry bubble bath were poured into the main penguin waterfall habitat.

title: The Velvet Rope Vanishing
description: The ultra-exclusive VIP club's crimson velvet stanchion ropes were replaced with braided licorice twists.

title: The Trophy Case Bowling Ball Swap
description: The championship gold bowling trophy was replaced with a frozen honey-glazed ham.

title: The Botanical Garden Cactus Hat Scandal
description: The rare hundred-year Saguaro cactus was crowned with a sombrero and glued-on googly eyes.

title: The Mona Lisa Bubblegum Tragedy
description: A single piece of pink bubblegum was stuck precisely onto the glass frame enclosing the Mona Lisa replica.

title: The Great Tapioca Spill of Tram #4
description: Forty pounds of cooked boba pearls were dumped down the funicular track cable housing.

title: The Stolen Chess Queen of St. Jude's
description: The grandmaster tournament's carved ivory queen piece was substituted with a salt shaker wrapped in tinfoil.
setting: St. Jude Chess Club Tournament Hall

title: The Hot Sauce Fire Extinguisher
description: The diner's emergency wall fire extinguisher was emptied and refilled with habanero buffalo sauce.

title: The Pigeon Tuxedo Conspiracy
description: Twelve town square pigeons were spotted wearing miniature tailored Velcro bowties and cummerbunds.

title: The Midnight Squeaky Floorboard Polish
description: The floor of the silent monastery was coated in high-gloss silicone buff, turning it into a treacherous ice rink.

title: The Missing Diamond Collar of Sir Paws
description: The rhinestone-encrusted silk collar was lifted from the sleeping Persian cat during the grand cat show.

title: The Submarine Hatch Padlock
description: The naval museum's historic decommissioned submarine had its top hatch padlocked shut with a glittery pink diary lock.

title: The Stolen Master Key of the Grand Hotel
description: The golden master skeleton key was removed from the concierge safe and replaced with a forged cardboard cut-out.

title: The Disappearing Fondue Fountain
description: The centerpiece four-tier Swiss chocolate fountain was swapped with a recirculating cheese fondue pump.

title: The Upside-Down Gallery Prank
description: All 18 paintings in the contemporary wing were turned precisely 180 degrees upside down without tripping alarms.

title: The Perfumery Vinegar Tampering
description: The tester bottle of $900-an-ounce 'Midnight Orchid' perfume was refilled with cloudy apple cider vinegar.
setting: Boutique Rue de Fleur Vanity Bar

title: The Stolen Golden Horseshoe
description: The historic lucky horseshoe nailed over the stable archway was plucked down and replaced with a horseshoe crab shell.

title: The Symphony Score Doodle Incident
description: The maestro's first-edition Beethoven 5th score had stick-figure mustaches inked onto every musical rest.

title: The Vanished Vintage Port Cask
description: A 1928 port barrel was drained in the wine cellar and refilled with store-bought grape soda.

title: The Disappearing Diamond Stylus
description: The audiophile lounge's $5,000 turntable diamond needle was swapped with a sharpened safety pin.

title: The High Roller Dice Switch
description: The craps table's precision acrylic dice were swapped with weighted foam novelty dice that always roll snake eyes.
setting: The Velvet Mirage Casino High Limit Room

title: The Clockwork Canary Theft
description: The antique jeweler's mechanical singing gold canary was snatched from its gilded Victorian cage.

title: The Great Wasabi Macaron Switch
description: A tray of mint-flavored French macarons was spiked with pure grated Japanese wasabi root paste.

title: The Midnight Fog Machine Siege
description: The city council chamber ventilation system was rigged with theatrical strawberry-scented dry ice smoke.

title: The Stolen Telescope Eyepiece
description: The university observatory's ultra-wide planetary lens was replaced with a kaleidoscopic party lens.

title: The Goldfish Bowl Champagne Toast
description: The crystal punchbowl at the governor's banquet was populated with seven live, swimming orange goldfish.

title: The Great Kazoo Symphony Sabotage
description: Every flutist's instrument case in the orchestra pit was replaced with a plastic metallic kazoo.

title: The Stolen Sovereign Mint Stamp
description: The commemorative bicentennial coin die stamp was purloined and replaced with a cookie cutter shape.

title: The Midnight Marquee Muddle
description: The vintage cinema marquee letters were rearranged to read 'FREE WEASELS IN THE BASEMENT TONIGHT'.
